s0.ru: Кузов вмещает {capacity}. Грузы подают строго по порядку, переставлять их нельзя: {listing}. Это {n} грузов. Если очередной не влезает, начинается новый рейс, а старый уезжает. Сколько рейсов потребуется?
s0.en: The truck holds {capacity}. Packages arrive in this fixed order and cannot be rearranged: {listing}. There are {n} packages. If the next one does not fit, a new trip starts and the current one leaves. How many trips are needed?

s1.en: The truck holds {capacity}. Packages arrive in this fixed order and cannot be rearranged: {listing}. There are {n} packages. If the next one does not fit, a new trip starts and the current one leaves. How much is loaded on the last trip?

s2.en: Package {i} of size {size}: trip {trip}, load {load} of {capacity}.
